criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.why: Same cover copy as cycle 1. In the contact sheet, 'Campus policies start first.' at 119.5 px reads instantly, UPDATE shows in the kicker, and the DEM state with three cyan pins is clearly Alaska. Three things hold it at 8. The 49.5 px line above it still competes for the first read, and the big line needs it ('start first' than what?). The new Gulf glint is a soft vertical light column running from the coast near x 1040 down into the footer band. At thumb size it reads as a spotlight or lens smear, not sun on water, and it pulls the eye away from UAF. The gold route still leaves into empty black.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.why: The craft cycle didn't touch the arc. 02 pays the cover. The gold route from 01 to 02 lands at matching height. The open February ring carries through 02, 07, 08 and 09, and on 08 it now visibly hovers, which strengthens the 'unset' beat. These still hold it at 7.5. Nothing on 03 plants the authorship question that 04 answers. 06, the conflict peak, is drawn as the same blue hillshade panel as 02. 'Campus policies start first / before the statement' is said on 01, 02 (body) and 07, so 07's headline nearly repeats the cover. 07 and 08 overlap ('campus by campus').

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.why: Real gains. 08's ring now reads as hovering, with a dashed drop line, a gold ground glow and a footprint ellipse, and the state is clipped with Canada sunk. 03's body copy now sits on clear sky, with only two faint peak ghosts below it near display y 820, so the cycle-1 contrast risk is gone. 03's machine contact rose from dL 9.2 to 17.1. 05's core is now a dense luminous stipple glow. The strong frames still carry the deck: 02 and 06 (device-resolution hillshade), 04 (contour engraving), 09 (depth-faded contours, Polaris glow) and 07. What keeps it at 7. 03 is still not a masterful-depth frame. The 'granite' is grey ellipses plus uniform black flecks, which reads as terrazzo or dalmatian, not biotite, feldspar and quartz. The 'flush' cap still stands proud on a raised white collar disc, so it reads as a puck on a saucer. The new haze band ends in a hard horizontal seam across the full width at display y about 875. A cold blue vignette blob sits on the lower-left of the rock (display about x 0 to 400, y 1750 to 1850). 01 still shows cotton-ball mottling instead of ridgelines and a lit straight 141st-meridian edge, and the new glint is a vertical beam, not a sea surface. 08's eastern border is still a lit straight wall (display x about 1100 to 1250, y 1165 to 1480), western Alaska is still a dim blobby slab, and a dark thread stub starts inside the ring's hollow. No frame yet meets 'real depth used masterfully'.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.why: 02's fork is a dashed line for the postponed vote plus three solid spurs for campus work (C01, C03). 03's tick rings carry 6, 4 and 5 (C24). 04's rails are asserted to 420, 84 and 840 px for 2, 0.4 and 4 pages. 07 has twelve equal month ticks after ADOPTION (C15). 08's hovering open ring with a drop line to the ground is now a more literal 'unset' anchor than in cycle 1. 05's stipple is decorative by design. A stranger could guess 'the order of a vote changed' from 02, 07 and 08, but not from 03 or 05.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.why: Real DEMs throughout (state, FNSB, Cook Inlet with Knik and Turnagain Arm, the Denali contours). UAA, UAF and UAS pins sit at real coordinates, with a real coordinate footer on every slide. Named people (Shier, Dewees, Cooper), named bodies (UAA Faculty Senate, AI Coordinating Council) and the meeting at UAF. The small doubt remains: the right edge of 04's 'DENALI MASSIF' contour field shows fjord and island forms.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.why: Each content slide adds a verified specific: February and the interim campus direction (02); four pages and 'doesn't establish policy', with 6/4/5 (03); Shier's 'about 20 percent' of a two-page draft and the 'all fed to Claude' fragment (04); nearly 200, mostly in Anchorage (05); the postponed reject-and-replace vote and the Dewees quote (06); the May to adoption sequence and the one-year clock (07); the curriculum carve-out and the Cooper quote (08). Hedges are honoured. 07's body partly restates 02 and the cover.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.why: The hero (raking-light relief survey) and the hook (order reversed) are new against the 11-11 to 11-14 decks, and Unbounded display is fresh. Reused subsystems: the navy and ice-blue palette sits near 11-11's, Manrope body repeats from 11-14, and DEM relief is a frequent house move. Inside the deck, the whole-state mesh repeats on 01 and 08, with similar overhead framing that the cycle didn't change, and the hillshade panel repeats on 02 and 06.
